posts.text: President Donald Trump's $1.4 billion earnings from his crypto ventures has become a major obstacle in Senate negotiations over the Clarity Act. Senate Republicans introduced revised language this week in an effort to end a months-long stalemate. Democrats and consumer watchdog groups quickly rejected the proposal, arguing that it does not include strong enough safeguards to prevent a sitting president or members of the president’s family from profiting from crypto businesses while the administration regulates the same industry. The dispute centers on Trump's memecoin and other family-linked crypto ventures, which critics say raise potential conflict-of-interest concerns. The disagreement could further delay legislation designed to clarify how cryptocurrencies and other digital assets are regulated in the United States.
posts.author: WatcherGuru

posts.text: BREAKING: China imported +173 tonnes of gold in June, the largest monthly import since March 2024. This also marks their 3rd consecutive monthly increase. As a result, China's total gold imports in the first half of 2026 doubled, to ~820 tonnes, the 2nd-largest first-half total on record. This is just ~10 tonnes below the first-half total record of ~830 tonnes set in 2025. The surge was driven by investors buying the dip and banks increasing gold imports to rebuild inventories amid strong retail demand. Meanwhile, gold-backed ETFs in China have attracted +28 tonnes of inflows year-to-date. China's appetite for gold is incredibly strong.
